name: Desogestrel
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Volnea (desogestrel and ethinyl estradiol), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — etonogestrel t½ 27.8±7.2 hours
halfLifeNotes: Desogestrel is a prodrug rapidly and completely converted to etonogestrel, so the value is etonogestrel's steady-state (Day 21) elimination half-life in women on the combination oral contraceptive; the parent itself has no clinically meaningful half-life.
